table.retrieve:
SELECT 	Item.Name,  
				aliasname=item.customicode, 
				active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
         		PurPrice = item.purprice,
         		SalePrice =item.saleprice,
				batch=godowndetail.batch,
				expiry=godowndetail.expiry,
         		Item.PackUnits,   
         		QTY = Case When (isnull(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN  (isnull(GodownDetail.CurrQty,0) / Item.PackUnits ) Else isnull(GodownDetail.CurrQty,0)  End,
         		LoosePack = Case When (isnull(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN ' ' Else 'L' End,
         		Manufacturer.name,
				classname=itemclass.name,
				Category=itemcategory.name,
				stockvalue=isnull(currqty,0)* (case :ai_pricetype when 1 then Round(item.saleprice/(case item.packunits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end ),2) when 2 then round(item.purprice/(case item.packunits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end ),2) when 3 then item.avgprice end)

FROM 	
			Manufacturer,   
			Item
			LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode),
			ItemCategory,
			itemclass

WHERE 
         	( Item.ICCode IN (:classcode ) ) and
			( itemclass.iccode = Item.iccode ) and
			( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
			( Item.active=1) and
			( Item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)
